seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Lake Wylie, SC 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Lake Wylie, SC: the Santa Parade and Movie at Field Day Park, a library visit from Santa and the Holiday Boat Parade.
lede: Lake Wylie celebrates Christmas on the water and in the park, with a lighted boat parade, a county park Santa parade and a library visit from Santa.
celebrates: York County Parks lists a Christmas Santa Parade and Movie at Field Day Park at Lake Wylie on Saturday, December 5, and the park's Facebook event gives the hours as 5 to 8 pm. The Lake Wylie Holiday Boat Parade glides past Papa Doc's Shore Club on Saturday, December 12, at 6:30 pm. The Lake Wylie Library welcomes Santa on Monday, December 21, from 10 am to noon in its meeting room, a library program that Rally lists as free. Papa Doc's Shore Club sits on the lake's South Carolina shore.
lastyear: York County's park pages describe Field Day Park at Lake Wylie as a 50 acre athletic complex in the Paddlers Cove subdivision, with multipurpose fields, baseball fields, batting cages, pickleball courts and a playground for ages 2 to 12. The county's 2026 events list shows the park hosting Halloween trick or treat on October 31 before the December 5 Santa parade, so the park has become a seasonal gathering place.
facts: Field Day Park's county page lists its 2026 events in order: Trick or Treat on October 31, a pickleball tournament on November 17 and 18 and the Christmas Santa Parade and Movie on December 5. The Lake Wylie Library program for Santa is listed on Rally's Rock Hill guide as free, and the boat parade starts from Papa Doc's Shore Club on the South Carolina side of the lake.
trains: Lake Wylie has no Christmas train ride on our pages. The closest holiday train in our Charlotte guide is THE POLAR EXPRESS train ride at the N.C. Transportation Museum in Spencer, north of Charlotte, which is a long drive from Lake Wylie. Closer to home, the Fort Mill Christmas Village on December 3 offers trackless trains for kids, and the Santa events on this page are the nearer holiday outings.
train_links: The museum in Spencer runs THE POLAR EXPRESS train ride in the Christmas season and is listed in our Charlotte guide.

faq: When is the Santa Parade at Field Day Park in Lake Wylie?

York County Parks lists a Christmas Santa Parade and Movie on Saturday, December 5, 2026, at Field Day Park at Lake Wylie, 1101 Field Day Lane. The park's Facebook event gives the hours as 5 to 8 pm. A price and the movie title are not printed on the host pages.
When is the Lake Wylie Holiday Boat Parade?

The Lake Wylie Holiday Boat Parade is listed for Saturday, December 12, 2026, from 6:30 to 7 pm, starting at Papa Doc's Shore Club on the South Carolina side of the lake. See the listing on our Rock Hill guide for the host's details.
Can kids meet Santa at the Lake Wylie Library?

Yes. The Lake Wylie Library lists a Visit from Santa on Monday, December 21, 2026, from 10 am to noon in the meeting room at 185 Blucher Circle, Lake Wylie, SC 29710. Rally's listing of the event shows it as free, so check that card for the library's details.
Is there a train ride near Lake Wylie?

Lake Wylie has no train ride on our pages. The Fort Mill Christmas Village on December 3 has trackless trains for kids, and the N.C. Transportation Museum in Spencer runs THE POLAR EXPRESS train ride, a much longer drive north of Charlotte. Check the museum site for dates and tickets.
